```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(dplyr)

# Participant counts are read from the data rather than typed in, so this page
# cannot drift from the analyses. Behavioural counts come from the PsychoPy
# files, ERP counts from the exported waveforms.
psy <- fs::dir_ls("~/Desktop/SP26_data/2_psychopy_data",
                  glob = "*StressLearning2025*.csv")
beh <- purrr::map_dfr(psy, \(f)
  readr::read_csv(f, col_select = "participant", col_types = "c",
                  progress = FALSE)) |>
  mutate(participant = suppressWarnings(as.integer(participant))) |>
  filter(!is.na(participant)) |>          # psychopy leaves some rows blank
  distinct(participant) |>
  mutate(group = if_else(participant < 200, "L1", "L2"))

erp <- readr::read_csv("~/Kaylee_SP26/sp26_waveforms_event.csv",
                       col_select = c("participant", "group"),
                       show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE) |>
  distinct(participant, group)

# named np() rather than n() so it does not shadow dplyr::n()
np <- function(d, g = NULL) {
  if (is.null(g)) nrow(d) else sum(d$group == g)
}
```

# Native and non-native prediction of word endings: Evidence from EEG

`r np(beh)` participants (`r np(beh, 'L1')` L1 Spanish speakers, `r np(beh, 'L2')` L2 learners) completed a three-phase Spanish stress-suffix association task in PsychoPy: pre-test (360 trials), training (120 trials with feedback), and post-test (360 trials). On each trial participants heard a spoken sentence and selected *PRESENTE* or *PASADO*.

There were six conditions in the pre- and post-test stimuli, varying in verb stress (paroxytone, oxytone), noun match (Match, Mismatch), and verb match (Match, Mismatch). There were two conditions in the training stimuli, paroxytone and oxytone, with no violations. EEG was recorded continuously and epoched at noun F0, verb F0, and suffix onset.

The six versions of one item are shown below.

| Condition | Sentence | Noun match | Verb stress | Verb match | Suffix |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | el dueño busca la llave | Match | paroxytone | Match | present |
| 2 | el dueño buscó la llave | Mismatch | oxytone | Match | past |
| 3 | el dueño buscó la llave | Match | paroxytone | Mismatch | past |
| 4 | el dueño busca la llave | Mismatch | paroxytone | Match | present |
| 5 | el dueño busca la llave | Match | oxytone | Mismatch | present |
| 6 | el dueño buscó la llave | Match | oxytone | Match | past |

## Participants

| | Total | L1 Spanish | L2 learners |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tested | `r np(beh)` | `r np(beh, 'L1')` | `r np(beh, 'L2')` |
| Behavioural analysis | `r np(beh)` | `r np(beh, 'L1')` | `r np(beh, 'L2')` |
| ERP analysis | `r np(erp)` | `r np(erp, 'L1')` | `r np(erp, 'L2')` |

Four participants were excluded from the ERP analysis for excessive artifact rejection. Details are on the ERP page.

## Analyses

- **[Behavioural](behavioral.html)**: accuracy and reaction time at pre-test and post-test, and across training.
- **[ERP](erp_results.html)**: event-related potentials at pre-test and post-test, time-locked to verb F0 and suffix onset.

Training-phase ERPs and the brain-to-behaviour analyses will be added as separate pages.
